title: Energy — Agile vs Alternatives
description: Octopus Agile cost against Flexible, Flexible E7, Cosy and 18M Fixed on the same usage

panels.title: Average all-in price (p/kWh)
panels.description: Total cost including standing charge divided by total kWh, over the selected range. Lower is better.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "strings"
cost = from(bucket: "Home Assistant")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "GBP" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "last_reset_str") and r.entity_id =~ /^octopus_energy_electricity_.*_previous_accumulative_cost(_cosy_octopus|_flexible_octopus|_flexible_octopus_economy_7|_octopus_18_fix)?$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "entity_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.value and exists r.last_reset_str)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: date.truncate(t: date.add(d: 1h, to: time(v: strings.replace(v: r.last_reset_str, t: " ", u: "T", i: 1))), unit: 1d), _value: r.value, tariff: if r.entity_id =~ /_cosy_octopus$/ then "Cosy" else if r.entity_id =~ /_flexible_octopus_economy_7$/ then "FlexE7" else if r.entity_id =~ /_flexible_octopus$/ then "Flexible" else if r.entity_id =~ /_octopus_18_fix$/ then "Fixed" else "Agile"}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d) and r._time < v.timeRangeStop)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id", "tariff", "_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id", "tariff"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "tariff"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["tariff"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.Agile and exists r.Cosy and exists r.Flexible and exists r.FlexE7 and exists r.Fixed)

kwh = from(bucket: "Home Assistant")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kWh" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "last_reset_str") and r.entity_id =~ /^octopus_energy_electricity_.*_previous_accumulative_consumption$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "entity_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.value and exists r.last_reset_str)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: date.truncate(t: date.add(d: 1h, to: time(v: strings.replace(v: r.last_reset_str, t: " ", u: "T", i: 1))), unit: 1d), _value: r.value, tariff: if r.entity_id =~ /_cosy_octopus$/ then "Cosy" else if r.entity_id =~ /_flexible_octopus_economy_7$/ then "FlexE7" else if r.entity_id =~ /_flexible_octopus$/ then "Flexible" else if r.entity_id =~ /_octopus_18_fix$/ then "Fixed" else "Agile"}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d) and r._time < v.timeRangeStop)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id", "tariff", "_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id", "tariff"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "kwh"})

join(tables: {c: cost, k: kwh}, on: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {kwh: 0.0, Agile: 0.0, Cosy: 0.0, Flexible: 0.0, FlexE7: 0.0, Fixed: 0.0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({kwh: accumulator.kwh + r.kwh, Agile: accumulator.Agile + r.Agile, Cosy: accumulator.Cosy + r.Cosy, Flexible: accumulator.Flexible + r.Flexible, FlexE7: accumulator.FlexE7 + r.FlexE7, Fixed: accumulator.Fixed + r.Fixed})
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Agile: r.Agile / r.kwh * 100.0, Cosy: r.Cosy / r.kwh * 100.0, Flexible: r.Flexible / r.kwh * 100.0, "Flex E7": r.FlexE7 / r.kwh * 100.0, "Fixed 18M": r.Fixed / r.kwh * 100.0}))

panels.title: Agile vs alternatives (cumulative £)
panels.description: Running total of Agile cost minus the alternative's cost over days where all tariffs have data. Above zero: Agile has cost more (behind). Below zero: ahead.
